hypotheses.explanation: Frontend server spans report errors across several routes, while their downstream calls and the checkout workflow complete successfully, localizing the failures to frontend request handling.
Currency calls show large frontend-side durations, including 50–69 ms calls against sub-millisecond server spans; the frontend aggregate duration also exceeds the currencyservice aggregate.
A recommendation call takes 67 ms from the frontend while the recommendationservice server span is about 3.6 ms, indicating delay on the call path outside the server span.
